title: Morgana
album: Lucro Sucio; Los Ojos Del Vacio

lyrics.text: Somewhere out in this barren field
Sittin' on a wreckage of thoughts
I can't wave 'cause I'm holdin' on
To the memories of what we once were
In the cold of this bayonet waltz
Those shells you've been waitin' for
Will it return what you've lost? Everyone's lost
Cursed the ground when you level us
But the past always comes back around
In service to a feral god
Oh-oh-oh-oh, I can't get you out of my mind
(I can't get you out of my mind)
I can't let you call the darkness to save everybody
Oh-oh-oh-oh, I can't let you go anymore
(I can't let you go anymore)
I can't stand you closin' your eyes, can't you see everybody?
My resolve, is it strong enough for you?
Somewhere out in the vacancy
The Seraphim are watchin' you hunt all of them down
They spend their phosphorus nights interred
If you just keep your eyes on the ground
You just might make it out
Because your sapphires were made of ghosts
Inside a torrent of dreams
Hidin' all the torment, 'cause you know that it's been chippin'
At the shoulders again
Oh-oh-oh-oh, I can't get you out of my mind
(I can't get you out of my mind)
I can't let you call the darkness to save everybody
Oh-oh-oh-oh, I can't let you go anymore
(I can't let you go anymore)
I can't stand you closin' your eyes, can't you see everybody? Ooh
